functions.name: AddInstance
functions.signature: AddInstance(Target, Instance Transform, World Space)
functions.docs: Add an instance to this component. Transform is given in local space of this component unless bWorldSpace is set.

functions.name: AddInstances
functions.signature: AddInstances(Target, Instance Transforms, Should Return Indices, World Space, Update Navigation)
functions.docs: Add multiple instances to this component. Transform is given in local space of this component unless bWorldSpace is set.

functions.name: AddInstanceWorldSpace
functions.signature: AddInstanceWorldSpace(Target, World Transform)
functions.docs: Add an instance to this component. Transform is given in world space.

functions.name: SetCustomDataValue
functions.signature: SetCustomDataValue(Target, Instance Index, Custom Data Index, Custom Data Value, Mark Render State Dirty)
functions.docs: Update custom data for specific instance

functions.name: SetNumCustomDataFloats
functions.signature: SetNumCustomDataFloats(Target, In Num Custom Data Floats)
functions.docs: Update number of custom data entries per instance. This applies to all instances and will reallocate the full custom data buffer and reset all values to 0

functions.name: GetInstanceTransform
functions.signature: GetInstanceTransform(Target, Instance Index, Out Instance Transform, World Space)
functions.docs: Get the transform for the instance specified. Instance is returned in local space of this component unless bWorldSpace is set.  Returns True on success.

functions.name: GetLODDistanceScale
